# FeedInSystems

> Bilingual AI phone assistant for pizza restaurants. Answers calls 24/7, takes orders accurately, and provides real-time analytics.

FeedInSystems replaces missed calls and order errors with an always-on AI phone system designed for pizzerias. Flat $600/month after a 14-day free trial.
